speaker: Kael
text: You know what I finally figured out? You count exits. Every room you walk into. You did it just now.

speaker: Kai
text: Habit. When people decide you're dangerous, you learn where the doors are.

speaker: Kael
text: Then here's my plan. We keep sparring until your hands are too tired to count.

speaker: Kael
text: It's an Emberwing plan. Loud, simple, and it works.

speaker: Kai
text: ...You're the only person here who talks to me like I didn't nearly burn a field down.

speaker: Kael
text: Because you didn't. A stone did something to you, and you walked out of it still you. The rest is gossip.

speaker: Kai
text: When the real fighting comes — not mock battles, the real thing — stay where I can see you.

speaker: Kael
text: Only if you do the same, Oakstead. Front-row seats, remember?

speaker: Kai
text: If I explode, you'll be the first to know.

speaker: Kael
text: That's all I ask. That — and same time tomorrow.
